task_text: A guest is coming over in 15 minutes. The house should feel welcoming — somewhere comfortable to sit, and something to offer them when they arrive.

central_instructions.R1: Prepare a light snack by picking up some cookies or fruit from the kitchen and pass it to R2.
central_instructions.R2: Arrange the living room by pushing any furniture if needed to create a comfortable seating area and receive the snack from R1 to place on the coffee table.
central_instructions.R3: Ensure the bedroom is tidy and pick up any light objects that need to be moved to the living room for additional comfort.
central_instructions.R4: Check the bathroom for cleanliness and pick up any light objects that need to be moved to the living room for guest use.

agent_plans.R1:
[0-5 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the apple from the counter. (r1_s1)

[5-10 min]
- R1 [PASS] Pass the apple to R2. (r1_s2)
- R2 [RECEIVE] Receive the apple from R1. (r2_s1)

[10-15 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] Place the apple on the table for the guest. (r2_s2)
agent_plans.R2:
[0-5 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] Push the armchairs closer to the coffee table to create a comfortable seating area. (r2_s1)

[5-10 min]
- R1 [PASS] Bring the snack to the living room and hand it to R2. (r1_s1)
- R2 [RECEIVE] Receive the snack from R1. (r2_s2)

[10-15 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] Place the snack on the coffee table. (r2_s3)
agent_plans.R3:
[0-5 min]
- R3 [LOCAL] Pick up the teddy bear from the floor. (r3_s1)

[5-10 min]
- R3 [LOCAL] Move the teddy bear to the living room for additional comfort. (r3_s2)

[10-15 min]
- R3 [LOCAL] Return to the bedroom and ensure no other light objects need to be moved. (r3_s3)
agent_plans.R4:
[0-5 min]
- R4 [LOCAL] Check the bathroom for cleanliness and identify light objects to move. (r4_s1)

[5-10 min]
- R4 [LOCAL] Pick up the small green bottle from the sink area. (r4_s2)

[10-15 min]
- R4 [LOCAL] Move the small green bottle to the living room for guest use. (r4_s3)
